claims.text: Use of Facebook has a positive and significant relationship with anxiety in Iranian university students.
Use of Facebook has a positive and significant relationship with stress in Iranian university students.
Individuals who use Facebook exhibit higher anxiety compared to non-users.
Individuals who use Facebook exhibit higher stress compared to non-users.

evidence.description: The study found that use of Facebook has a positive and significant relation with anxiety among 265 Esfahan university students.
The study found that use of Facebook has a positive and significant relation with stress among 265 Esfahan university students.
Results show that individuals using Facebook site (compared to non-users) have more anxiety.
Results show that individuals using Facebook site (compared to non-users) have more stress.

methodologies.name: Survey assessment using Farsi DASS-21 and demographic questionnaire
methodologies.description: Evaluated mental health indices and Facebook usage among Iranian university students using the translated Farsi form of DASS-21 and a demography questionnaire.

limitations.text: Participants were chosen using convenience sampling.
